subject: Order our chicken and eggs online 🐓 🥚
preview: Enjoy chicken and eggs from the farm all year round by ordering online for delivery or pickup.
body:
[PHOTO 1: the order page on a laptop, assets/images/online-ordering.png]

You can now order from us online. Visit https://www.northfosterfarm.com/order/ to see our catalog, which includes everything we bring to market, from eggs by the dozen to whole chickens, sausage, and every cut in between.

The way it works: choose what you'd like, pick how you want to receive it, and pay by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay or Venmo. Order placed and confirmation in your inbox in no time.

There are three ways to get your order:

DELIVERY
- We deliver every week on Thursday, between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM
- Order by noon on Wednesday
- As affordable as possible: $40 minimum, $5 fee, free on orders of $150 or more

ON-FARM PICKUP
- Pickup on select weekdays, by appointment
- No fee, no minimum
- 99 East Killingly Road, Foster, RI 02825

DROP SITE
- Back on Saturday mornings in Scituate, 10:00 to 11:00 AM, starting October 17
- Village Green, 46 Institute Lane, North Scituate, in the same corner of the lot where our tent sits in market season
- Pick up your order for free

Do we deliver to you? Check your ZIP code on the map at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/#map. We deliver across western and central Rhode Island, and just over the line in Connecticut, where we can deliver eggs only for now. Our delivery policy lists every town, along with our bulk discounts, from $5 off orders of $50 up to $20 off orders of $200: https://www.northfosterfarm.com/delivery-policy/

You don't need an account to order. If you'd like one, there's no password: type the email you order with at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/login/ and we'll send you a link that signs you in. Signed-in customers can see past orders and receipts, change or cancel an order in progress, and keep a delivery address on file.

[PHOTO 2: our red hens on the pasture, assets/images/chickens.jpg]

Our freezers are fully stocked, and our hens, although slowing down, will continue to lay for us all year round. We aim to keep you fully supplied from here all the way to next market season.

This is the first version of our online ordering system, and we want to hear how it works for you. If anything is confusing, or something you want isn't there, or you run into any problems, just reply to this email.

One last thing: we're moving farm news to a new list, and it only goes to people who ask for it. This is the last update we'll send to this one. Tomorrow morning you'll get one more email from us, with a Sign up button. Click it within a week and you're on the new list; ignore it and you won't hear from us again. You can also sign up any time at https://www.northfosterfarm.com/news/, or tick the email box when you place an order.

The NFF team

---

You're getting this because you joined the North Foster Farm email list. Reply with "unsubscribe" and we won't send you the sign-up email either. Follow along on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/northfosterfarm
